purpose: Measure high-level CPU/GPU contributions before selecting an optimization. No thermal-policy or quality changes. Existing enableFrameTimingStats already enabled.
limits: Delayed single completed-frame samples; not five-second peaks, compositor trace, definitive CPU/GPU bottleneck classification or a thermal diagnosis. API can affect GPU workload, particularly GLES. Development/Editor-only calls; future controlled device comparisons must use like-for-like instrumentation.
